camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public CreateUdfFile --region cn-hangzhou --FileName StringConcat --FunctionType STRING --ClassName 'com.alibaba.DataWorks.api.udf.StringConcat' --FileFolderPath 'Business_process/First_Business_Process/function/string_processing' --Resources 'string-concat-1.0.0.jar,commons-lang-2.6.jar'
description_en: Creates a file for a function in DataStudio
description_zh: 调用CreateUdfFile，在数据开发中创建函数类型文件
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-udf-file --file-folder-path Business_process/First_Business_Process/function/string_processing --file-name StringConcat --function-type STRING --class-name com.alibaba.DataWorks.api.udf.StringConcat --resources string-concat-1.0.0.jar,commons-lang-2.6.jar --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUdfFile

parameters.help_en: The path to the folder containing the function file
parameters.help_zh: 函数文件所在的文件夹路径
parameters.name: file_folder_path

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. To find this, click the wrench icon in the upper-right corner and navigate to the workspace management page
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID，
您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The function category, corresponding to the function type field in the Create Function form. Valid values: MATH (mathematical functions), AGGREGATE (aggregate functions), STRING (string processing functions), DATE (date processing functions), ANALYTIC (window functions), and OTHER (other functions)
parameters.help_zh:
函数的分类，对应创建函数表单中的函数类型一项，
包括MATH（数学运算函数）、AGGREGATE（聚合函数）、STRING（字符串处理函数）、DATE（日期处理函数）、ANALYTIC（窗口函数）和OTHER（其他函数）
parameters.name: function_type

parameters.help_en: The class name where the function is defined, corresponding to the class name field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数定义所在的类名，
对应创建函数表单的类名一项
parameters.name: class_name

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of resource names referenced by the function, corresponding to the resource list field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数引用的资源名列表，对应创建表中的资源列表。
多个资源名称之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resources

parameters.example: Concatenate several strings to generate a new string
parameters.help_en: The function purpose description, corresponding to the description field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数用途的说明，
对应创建函数表单中的描述
parameters.name: udf_description

parameters.help_en: The command format for invoking the function, corresponding to the command format field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数调用的命令格式，
对应创建函数表单中的命令格式
parameters.name: cmd_description

parameters.example: List of strings to be connected
parameters.help_en: The function parameter description, corresponding to the parameter description field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数入参的说明，
对应创建函数表单中的参数说明
parameters.name: parameter_description

parameters.example: New strings generated by concatenating all strings before and after the input order
parameters.help_en: The return value description, corresponding to the return value field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数的返回值说明，
对应创建函数表单中的返回值
parameters.name: return_value

parameters.help_en: An example demonstrating how to call the function, corresponding to the example field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh:
函数调用示例，
对应创建函数表单中的示例
parameters.name: example

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the identifier at the top of the Data Studio page where you switch workspaces
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，
即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create the directory if the specified path (FileFolderPath) does not exist. Valid values:

true: Automatically creates the directory if it does not exist.

false: The call fails if the directory does not exist
parameters.help_zh:
当参数中指定的目录（FileFolderPath）在系统中不存在时，
是否自动创建此目录。取值如下：

true：若此目录不存在，自动创建此目录

false：若此目录不存在，调用失败
parameters.name: create_folder_if_not_exists

Data.description_en: The file ID after successful creation

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题
